title: La Union replacing typhoon-damaged hanging bridge in Balaoan

blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan — The provincial government of La Union will build a 96-meter bridge in Barangay Bungol in Balaoan to replace a hanging bridge destroyed by Typhoon Emong (international name: Co-May) in July 2025. The new bridge, which will cross the Nagsipol River, will cost nearly P12 million, funded by the provincial government. Construction is scheduled to start this month, the provincial government said. Gov. Mario Eduardo C. Ortega led the groundbreaking ceremony on Oct. 8 for the project, which aims to provide safer and more convenient access to residents of Barangays Bungol, Arosip and Lacong.
